title: Canon 20x22 Field Map
prompt:
High-angle cinematic storyboard of the Garreg Mach academy mock battle adapted from the Rivalry of the Houses map. Blue Lions start on the southeast edge; the mid-west lane shows early enemy movement; wooded thickets and low stone walls mark Golden Deer cover; the northeast contains red-black Black Eagles pressure and two faculty heal-tile positions. It is supervised and nonlethal with wooden or blunted weapons, but the geography is one continuous outdoor tactical field, not separate target ranges. Youthful academy students, no UI.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: whistle carries from classroom cut into field overview. Transition out: cut on Byleth marking the southeast route in dirt. Screen/camera rule: establish southeast Blue Lions start, mid-west first pressure, wooded thickets, and northeast heal-tile danger as one continuous map. Audio bridge: whistle, training wood, distant student movement. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: high wide establishing shot, slow tactical tilt down

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: game grid, real blood, lethal battlefield, anonymous adult soldiers, old faces, modern objects, text, watermark
transition_in: whistle carries from classroom cut into field overview
transition_out: cut on Byleth marking the southeast route in dirt
screen_direction_rule: establish southeast Blue Lions start, mid-west first pressure, wooded thickets, and northeast heal-tile danger as one continuous map
audio_bridge: whistle, training wood, distant student movement
risk_notes: Must read as one canon-inspired outdoor tactical map, not three small training yards.
